base_value_source: H1 FY2026 Unaudited Interim Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements, Statement of Income, p.5
base_value_note: Reported IFRS net income; no reported EBITDA is available. The sole clean per-unit coefficient below moves financial-instrument fair value, not reported net income, so the deterministic engine must withhold a new income level and margin.

sensitivities.label: Parallel interest-rate curves
sensitivities.non_linearity: The disclosed whole-position DV01 is symmetric for a ±1bp parallel shift in the Brazilian, Turkish, US, Mexican and Colombian curves and includes the current hedge posture. It is a fair-value sensitivity, not an earnings or EBITDA sensitivity; linear scaling outside ±1bp is not validated.
sensitivities.source: H1 FY2026 Unaudited Interim Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements, Note 32, p.42: 06/30/2026 DV01s of −US$0.685m BRL, −US$0.125m TRY, +US$0.002m US, −US$0.059m MXN and −US$0.415m COP = −US$1.282m per +1bp parallel shift
